notes: Governmental activities are on a modified cash basis, business-type on accrual; treated as GAAP-style with fund balances. Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (p6). Business-type from proprietary funds statement total column (p8); no printed single total, so receipts (operating revenues + nonoperating gain on investments and grant income) and disbursements (operating expenses + interest expense) computed. Transfers to other funds (160,000) in business_type.transfers_net match governmental transfer in. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1); governmental ending_cash is the governmental funds balance sheet Total cash and cash equivalents (-439,804, p4, negative as printed; CDs, county treasurer cash and investments are separate). Proprietary cash flows: investing section not presented (interest received is in capital and related financing). General Fund budgetary comparison (p11) not recorded in detail to avoid double counting with the more detailed departmental combining statement (pp17-18); the departmental statement is recorded per department. Ambulance and library capital outlay shown as capital outlay, matching the statement's separate Capital outlay line. Escher/Foss/Sales Tax expenditure totals printed as nothing/dash (0). Ending investments (CDs 702,111 + investments 594,971 = 1,297,082, p4) recorded separately; with county treasurer cash 5,861 and cash (439,804), governmental cash and investments total 863,139 (= total assets and fund balance). Re-check 2026-10-28 (attempt 2): business-type 'Purchased energy' 500,886 moved to cost type Purchased Power/Cost of Sales (function utilities); 'Utilities and telephone' tagged function utilities. Intergovernmental lines have no printed breakdown (pp11-12, 17), so not split. Re-check 2026-10-29 (attempt 3): proprietary 'Sales' 1,181,520 (Electric/Water/Sewer/Trash funds, p8) moved to Utility Charges; governmental 'Charges for services and rental fees' 59,547 (p6, General Fund only) split by the General Fund departments schedule (Total column 59,547, p18): General 7,080 stays charges for services, Ambulance 42,760 Ambulance Fees, Pool 5,162 + Park 1,245 Recreation Fees, Community Building 3,300 Rentals; the matching detail lines take the same categories. Read pages 1-18 of 18.
